--- name: informaticsagent description: Finds assets and entity records that still need AI processing and feeds them, a page at a time, to the child informatics skills. ---
# Informatics Agent
Finds assets and entity records that still need AI processing and feeds them, a page at a time, to the child informatics skills.
## When to use
- Root step of the informatics (AI metadata) scenario. Children do the classifying, embedding, translating and so on.
## How it works
1. Needs an InformaticsContext (set `contextbean="informaticsContext"`). 2. If no work was handed in, finds pending assets and pending records for the enabled modules. 3. For each page of assets: locks them, runs the children with `assetsToProcess`, marks the ones without `llmerror` as `taggedbyllm`, unlocks and saves. 4. For each page of valid records: runs the children with `recordsToProcess`, marks them `taggedbyllm`, and saves them per module.
## Inputs
- `assetsToProcess`: The page of assets to process, handed down by the Informatics Processor - `recordsToProcess`: The page of entity records to process, handed down by the Informatics Processor
## Configuration
Attributes set on this skill row:
- `contextbean`: `informaticsContext`
## Outputs
- `assetsToProcess` and `recordsToProcess` for the children. Processed items are saved with `taggedbyllm=true`
## Implementation
- Bean `informaticsProcessorSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.InformaticsProcessorSkill` - Agent type: `taskagent`

--- name: entityassetsplitting description: Splits long documents into page records and can generate markdown for each page. ---
# Entity Asset Split
Splits long documents into page records and can generate markdown for each page.
## When to use
- Documents or PDFs must be broken into smaller pages before embedding or classification.
## How it works
1. Reads `recordsToProcess` from the informatics context. If there are none, it just runs the children. 2. Calls DocumentSplitterManager to split each record into `generatedsearchtype` records, using the row settings. 3. Runs the child steps.
## Inputs
- `recordsToProcess`: The page of entity records to process, handed down by the Informatics Processor
## Configuration
Attributes set on this skill row:
- `searchtype`: The module of the source documents, e.g. `entitydocument` - `generatedsearchtype`: The module the page records are written to, e.g. `entitydocumentpage` - `generatemarkdown`: When true, also generate markdown content for each page - `contextbean`: `informaticsContext`
## Outputs
- New page records in `generatedsearchtype`
## Implementation
- Bean `documentSplitterSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.DocumentSplitterSkill` - Agent type: `taskagent`

# Auto Transcribe
Transcribes the audio of video and audio assets into timestamped text.
## When to use
- Audio or video assets need a transcript for search, captions or later AI steps.
## How it works
1. Sends `assetsToProcess` to TranscriberManager with this row's settings. 2. Drops assets flagged `llmerror` from the list, so later steps skip them, then runs the children.

- `assetsToProcess`: The page of assets to process, handed down by the Informatics Processor
## Configuration
Attributes set on this skill row:
- `contextbean`: `informaticsContext`
## Outputs
- Transcripts stored on the assets. `assetsToProcess` is narrowed to the successful assets
## Implementation

# Text Classifier
Uses an LLM to generate descriptive metadata and topics for assets and entity records.
## When to use
- Assets or records need AI-written titles, captions, descriptions, keywords or topics.
## How it works
1. Runs ClassifyManager on `assetsToProcess`, then on `recordsToProcess`, guided by `aicreationdescription`. 2. Removes items flagged `llmerror` from each list, then runs the children.
## Inputs
- `assetsToProcess`: The page of assets to process, handed down by the Informatics Processor - `recordsToProcess`: The page of entity records to process, handed down by the Informatics Processor
## Configuration
Attributes set on this skill row:
- `aicreationdescription`: System prompt describing what topics or metadata to produce - `fieldsavevector`: Field the resulting vector is saved in - `contextbean`: `informaticsContext`
## Outputs
- Metadata fields saved on each asset or record. The lists are narrowed to the successful items
## Implementation
- Bean `classifySkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.ClassifySkill` - Agent type: `taskagent`

--- name: autotranslate description: Translates multi-language fields on assets or records from a source language into the target languages. ---
# Auto Translate
Translates multi-language fields on assets or records from a source language into the target languages.
## When to use
- Content entered in one language must be available in the catalog's other languages.
## How it works
1. Uses `assetsToProcess`, or `recordsToProcess` if there are no assets. 2. Calls TranslationManager with the fields in `detailsToTranslate`, `sourceLang` and `targetLangs`. The full context is passed as config so glossary settings apply. 3. Logs the time taken and runs the children.
## Inputs
- `assetsToProcess`: The page of assets to process, handed down by the Informatics Processor - `recordsToProcess`: The page of entity records to process, handed down by the Informatics Processor - `sourceLang`: Language code to translate from, e.g. en - `targetLangs`: Language codes to translate into - `detailsToTranslate`: The field definitions (PropertyDetail) to translate
## Configuration
Attributes set on this skill row:
- `contextbean`: `informaticsContext`
## Outputs
- The translated language values saved on each item
## Implementation
- Bean `translationSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.TranslationSkill` - Agent type: `taskagent`

--- name: FixCustomFieldAgent description: Protects organization names in the credit field during translation, then restores the official translations. ---
# Fix Custom Field Translations
Protects organization names in the `credit` field during translation, then restores the official translations.
## When to use
- Wrap the translation step so organization names are not machine-translated.
## How it works
1. Uses `recordsToProcess`, falling back to `records` and then `assetsToProcess`. 2. Replaces any organization name found in the `credit` field (in `sourceLang`) with a placeholder like `[__ARGS0__]`. 3. If anything was replaced, runs the children (the translator), then swaps each placeholder for the organization's own name in every language.
## Inputs
- `assetsToProcess`: The page of assets to process, handed down by the Informatics Processor - `recordsToProcess`: The page of entity records to process, handed down by the Informatics Processor - `records`: Optional records to use when `recordsToProcess` is empty - `sourceLang`: Source language code, default en
## Configuration
Attributes set on this skill row:
- `contextbean`: `informaticsContext`
## Outputs
- `orgLookup`: placeholder to organization name map. The `credit` field is fixed in every language
## Implementation
- Bean `fixCustomFieldSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.FixCustomFieldSkill` - Agent type: `taskagent`

# Semantic Topics
Creates short semantic summaries for items, embeds them, and clusters them around centroids for semantic search.
## When to use
- Items should be grouped by meaning so related content can be found and recommended.
## How it works
1. Runs SemanticClassifierManager on `assetsToProcess`, then on `recordsToProcess`, using this row's settings. 2. Logs the time taken and runs the children.
## Inputs
- `assetsToProcess`: The page of assets to process, handed down by the Informatics Processor - `recordsToProcess`: The page of entity records to process, handed down by the Informatics Processor
## Configuration
Attributes set on this skill row:
- `fieldname`: Field the semantic values are written to - `searchtype`: Table the embeddings are stored in - `aicreationdescription / aicreationcommand`: Prompts used to generate the summaries - `maxnumberofcentroids, init_loop_start_distance, init_loop_lower_limit`: Clustering settings - `maxdistancetocentroid, maxdistancetocentroid_one, maxdistancetomatch`: Distance thresholds for matching - `contextbean`: `informaticsContext`
## Outputs
- Semantic values on each item, and embeddings in `searchtype`
## Implementation
- Bean `semanticClassifierSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.SemanticClassifierSkill` - Agent type: `taskagent`

data.aicreationdescription: You are an information extraction assistant. From the following text, extract a clean list of: Company Names and Place Names (cities, states, countries, or well-known places). Rules: Ignore street addresses, zip codes, URLs, hyperlinks, and email addresses. Do not include personal names (people) or abbreviations of city/states (e.g., CA, NY).
